# Spinner

```ts
import { Spinner } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Spinner communicates that work is in progress when no meaningful completion amount is available. Use it inside a loading region, button, or initial page state. Use Progress Bar instead when an operation can report a determinate amount of completed work.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `'primary' \| 'greyscale'` | `'primary'` | Semantic color treatment from the Figma color variant. |
| `fill` | `'all' \| '3/4' \| '2/3' \| '1/2' \| '1/3' \| '1/4' \| '1/8' \| 'none'` | `'3/4'` | Visual arc from the Figma filled variant. This is deliberately visual only: Spinner always exposes indeterminate progress semantics. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'lg'` | Figma size: sm is 16px, md is 24px, and lg is 32px. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `true` | Rotates the visual arc to indicate ongoing work. Reduced-motion users see the same static arc. |

Also accepts all `Omit<
    React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixProgress.Root>,
    'children' | 'max' | 'value'
  >` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Spinner />
<Spinner aria-label="Loading search results" />
<Spinner size="sm" />
<Spinner size="md" color="greyscale" />
<Spinner fill="1/2" />
<Spinner animated={false} fill="3/4" />
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-primary-primary`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--color-stroke-border-low`, `--radius-1000`

## Accessibility

- Radix Progress supplies the progressbar role and indeterminate semantics because Spinner passes value={null}.
- Give every Spinner a specific aria-label when more than one loading region is present; the default name is Loading.
- Spinner has no focus stop because it is display-only.
- Motion uses GPU-only transform and stops when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use Spinner while a result has no reliable completion amount. | Use it to communicate an exact upload percentage. |
| Give concurrent loading regions distinct accessible labels. | Leave several spinners named only Loading on the same view. |
| Use the greyscale treatment for secondary context. | Invent non-semantic spinner colors. |
| Use animated={false} for a static status illustration. | Animate in a way that ignores reduced-motion preferences. |
